name: Commanding Presence
body:
Even in the heat of battle, your word carries significant weight. You’re able to snap your allies out of things that would otherwise hinder it.

Prerequisites: Leadership, Legendary Leader, Leadership score 10+

Benefit: As a standard action, you’re able to issue a command to an ally within 30 feet. This command gives the ally a new saving throw against any mind-affecting, charm, or compulsion effect the ally is currently under. If the effect doesn’t currently have a save DC, use 10+1/2 caster level of caster + the caster’s Charisma modifier. You may use this ability once a day for every 5 points of Leadership score you possess.
